page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal section numbers (§) in the right margin and a few on the left. Running head at top. Catchword at lower right. Below a rule, a chapter heading, then a paragraph with a drop cap, and a catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: dicitur, reliquis membris heterogeneum; & a corpore Ecclesiæ, quum ratio tulerit, amputandum esse. §. 5.
Papam, etiamsi Speculatorem præ se ferat, speculam tamen ipsam jam olim deseruisse. §. 6.
Ambrosij diuinissimi viri exemplum [?] esse. §. 7. ejicere, & reiicere.
Vniuersum orbem Pontificis esse dioecesin, totius orbis omni praxi & suffragijs refragari. §. 8.
Odiosum Oecumenici, seu Vniuersalis Episcopi Titulum à Gregorio Papa damnatum probari. §. 9.
Pontifices nihil minus quàm docendo Monitores agere. §. 10.
Pontificibus Rom. nimis adhærere, fatale Principibus nonnunquam fuisse. §. 11.
Pontifices ipsos omnium maximè ad sua monita audires, & pectora obturare. §. 12.
Bellarmini Precationem neque hic vndequaque ver-ram; & eius generis aliam tantùm non blasphemam esse. § 13.
Reges Christianos, quoad curam subditorum, speculatores habendos esse. §. 14.
main_text.head: In C A P. V.
De V. Tit. Papæ, vz. Sacerdote Magno, &c.
main_text.p: HISce titulis, [Summus, & Maximus Pontifex] aliorum Episcoporum ordinem & dignitatem æqualem non imminui. §. 1.
Immodica Pontificiorum, de Papis, Elogia & Christianis hominibus horrori, & ipsi Christo dedecori esse. §. 2.
Formam regiminis politici, sub vet. Testamento, Principe noui Test. exemplo proponi posse. §. 3.
Mosen, & Iosuam, qua Principes, Sacerdotibus præfuisse. §. 4.

page.notes: Page is a numbered page with no printed page number visible. Text in the centre is partly overprinted by show-through from the reverse side (mirrored lines), which was ignored. The word after "exemplum" in the Ambrosij paragraph is obscured and marked [?]. The word "ver-ram" in the Bellarmini line is hyphenated at the line end; its reading is doubtful. "vz." in the chapter heading is uncertain. Section numbers were placed as marginal notes beside their lines; the §. 7 and §. 13 marks stand at the left margin. Drop cap "H" is the first letter of "Hisce".
